{{Quote|Major Cressen--First Organa Regiment. I'm in charge of holding this area against the usurper who calls himself King Ulgo.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Corlis Brado Cressen|Cressen]]|<ref name="TOR:TSG" />}}
The '''First Organa Regiment''' was a military unit of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that served the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] in the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During this time, this unit was led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Corlis Brado Cressen|Cressen]] and tasked with holding a region of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] from the forces of the [[House Ulgo]].<ref name="TOR:TSG" />
